items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I don't know Sadie. I heard somebody, she sang on radio, play piano. Sadie Crosby, playing piano.

ctx.x: Who is Sadie Crosby now? I don't know Sadie. I heard somebody, she sang on radio, play piano. Sadie Crosby, playing piano.
What do you mean there was a piano play here by that night? Sadie Crosby.
